item.content:encoded:
This article was a ride. I instantly recognized the image from the Russian Sleep Experiment, and I was about to sigh or laugh until I read the rest of the article. The part that disturbed me the most was how the now-blind individuals just carry on with their lives like they've always been blind, now stuck to the whims of this monstrosity. That was what scared me the most, and I sort of wish the article ended at the event gamma.

The interview just made the whole thing less threatening to me, like it was twirling it's mustache while discussing its plans to destroy the world or something. It made it more human bug in a bad way, and it threw the rest of the build-up the article had going for it. That being said, the first half is still very scary, and the image, however famous, is still creepy. No-vote.

This is one of the first SCPs I ever read (I still have nightmares).
Anyway, this SCP has a very strange and confusing vibe to it (but that's a good thing). It is especially an oddity in this sea of SCPs in which we voyage through.
My explanation of SCP-957 goes as follows: This "thing" is an extra terrestrial/interdimensional being which has, along with several others of its kind, arrived at our planet to research human gullibility. They study this attribute by convincing the human subject that the two are related, and observing what lengths the human will go to for the being masquerading as the human's family member.
But hey, that's just a theory. An SCP theory!

item.title: Possible Link Between SCP-096 and SCP-957
item.content:encoded:
So from the picture, and the SCP-957 page, the addendum omega, and the footnotes. It is in my best opinion that somehow SCP-096 and 957 are related to each other.

Collapse long posts on the forums, please
hide

Comparisons

  • The appearances and height have some similarities, albeit that 096 is taller than 957, but are both 2m and taller, pale/ white skin, emaciated and very thin because 957 is devoid of organs, yet 096 is just plain skinny.
  • Both are unreasonably strong, yet look very weak due to their anatomy.
  • Both cannot be restrained or controlled due to its disproportionate strength.
  • Both are psychologically linked between their primary victim or SCP-(096/957)-1
  • Both have no known/ visible genitalia gender and are humanoid in shape, yet could be considered "male" due to their physical characteristics.
  • Both SCPs speak an unknown language/ incoherent, however 957 can speak English. 957's language is partially translated however.
  • When SCP-957-1 is teleported away after being shoved into the chest cavity, then comes back with an altered memory and missing his eyes/ blind, it reminded me of 096 and how it looks to be blind, yet can navigate across continents to find its viewer, just as 957-1 believes it has been blind all of its life, yet can still navigate around successfully and have a psychological connection with its host/ controller/ master- 957.
  • SCP-096 is considered a non sentient being for the lack of ability to be interviewed and communicated which is made more difficult with its incoherent babbling possibly due to a mental breakdown hinted in addendum omega, similar to 957's lack of cooperation with interviews, yet considered sentient because it can speak English, despite the fact that a psychological link between SCP-096 and SCP-096-1 is developed upon viewing its face, which is a sign of sentience, yet not considered.
  • 957's chest cavity is large enough to fit a person through it/ can be enlarged to fit a person whole, 096's mouth has the capability to open up to 4 times the normal human size and consumes its victim in large pieces/ whole which is facilitated due to its strength, yet when 096 has been damaged to the point where its organs are falling out, no human remains of its victims were or have been reported to be seen emerging from its body. This could link the two with the capability to transport objects across dimensions as their victims have disappeared whole, with the exception of SCP-957-1 returning in an altered state.
  • When SCP-957-2 (Lured human subject by SCP-957-1) Is engulfed by the black sphere and according to footnote 2, the subject can return with extra limbs and rearranged appendages(altered physical anatomy), which can be related to SCP-096's long arms and appendages, this could mean that SCP-096 is a "family" member that has been modified and experimented on.
  • SCP-957 addendum omega refers to 957 having a conversation with another entity and in footnote 3 refers to a redacted description of another SCP that is being investigated by the foundation, possibly 096, and it is also known that 096 is supposed to have been terminated a long time ago since its capture (Requested by the first recovery team's captain), yet is still alive and has not been terminated (In accordance with the game mind you) due to the possible investigation between the two SCPs.
  • In addendum omega, 957 talks to an unknown entity about its form being painful/ dirty/ unclean/ physical/ restraining and proceeds to stretch after it has been reminded of it, which it could be considered a weak link to 096 when it stretches its mouth open after someone sees it and possibly reminds it due to the sudden psychological connection, that it still exists in its current painful/ dirty/ unclean/ physical/ restraining form, according to 957.
  • 957 during its conversation with its "family" member, it has shown distress and concern with being in its physical form, and the member stresses patience, and attempts to calm 957 and reassures that its work is very necessary, this can be connected to 096 and its possible insanity or unsound mind which has been a result from prolonged exposure to either this planet or dimension and has led to its lack of "sentience" and incoherent babbling language which does not make sense in the first place and could also be a mixture of English and the unknown language which 957 has shown to know and speak. however most of the language that 957 uses with its "family" members has been translated, a lack of evidence or strong conviction of a connection between the two may be a reason why the applied knowledge of the mainly translated language of 957 has not been compared to the incoherent babbling that 096 begins to speak after its face is viewed.
  • The visual link that is created between SCP-096 and the viewer when its face is seen, whether it be from a camera, a photo, or the naked eye. This strange phenomena cannot be explained through normal logic, as both SCPs may exist in higher dimensions where current logic cannot be applied, as we have not been able to "attain" such "enlightenment" that would permit us the ability to solve this puzzling phenomena.

Odd vice versa occurrences

  • 096 is psychologically linked and is aggressive toward 096-1 and has no problem with physical contact toward them as it proceeds to [DATA REDACTED], or eat them.
  • 957's psychologically linked 957-1 exhibits emotions of compassion or intimacy towards 957, yet refuses to touch 957.
  • Upon interaction/ viewing the SCPs, SCP-096 supposedly has never had vision, but SCP-096-1 does. However, SCP-957 retains its vision and SCP-957-1 loses its vision, but believes it has never had vision its whole life after its mental/ psychological change.
  • SCP-096 seeks out SCP-096-1, but SCP-957-1 seeks out SCP-957.
  • SCP-096-1 is sought out by SCP-096, in which
  • The flip is that SCP-096 and SCP-096-1, are the opposite case of SCP-957 and SCP-957-1 and vice versa.

Conclusion

The referenced SCP in addendum omega and footnotes 2 & 3, SCP-096 may be another form/ version/ related "family" member of SCP-957 that has gone mentally insane or has been punished for going against the "family" by removing its disguise, resulting in him being punished by being sent to earth or the existential plane of our dimension, leading to mental insanity after either it, or the "family" had altered its body to create a psychological link toward its viewer(s) rather than the blind person, or SCP-957-1 having a link toward SCP-957. Should anyone/thing see its face, and attack and consume them, only to what appears to be to send the bodies to the "family" and to regenerate any lost tissue during its episodes of violent retrieval of SCP-096-1(s).
SCP-096 may have created this effect on itself after being punished by the "family" or having gone insane from its prolonged "studies" in the 3rd dimension, then began showing hatred towards the "family" and made the physical alterations to itself, should the "family" ever try to retrieve it and bring it back to them, resulting in them seeing 096 and attacking them with increased strength as a form of revenge for the possible punishment.
Or SCP-096 could be a member of the family that has been experimented on to act autonomously and may have gone awry with how aggressive he becomes when his face is observed.

Addendum Alpha

-It should also be noted that if there would be an event in which SCP-096 and SCP-957 were to meet, the consequences could be dire as these two either may create an inter-dimensional event that could destroy this planet IF they are related to each other. SCP-096 may not have the believed "sentience" or proper methods of thought and planning necessary to interact or fight an inter-dimensional being such as SCP-957, however he may be a lost member of the "family" and they may attempt to reclaim him, however if they "view" him, or what could be the equivalent of seeing to these extra-dimensional beings, he may attack them, then after using his unparalleled strength, tear/create holes between dimensions that may be unstable and collapse and create black holes etc.

Addendum Beta

-Should the collapse of dimensions related to the members of the "family" occur due to interactions with SCP-096 and SCP-957/ those of the "family". Class events that may result of this can be-

  • XK-Class, end of the world due to supernatural event/ entity(ies)
  • ZK-Class, end of reality/ destruction of the universe
  • ΩK-Class, end of the known universe/ dimension collapse, resulting in which even the laws of physics are broken.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Perhaps they could be properly containing the thing — I mean, with methods a little more secure than occupying one of the nearest houses. Lock down the neighborhood. Keep civilians out entirely. Restrain the thing — and yes, you do mention that they've tried, and unsuccessfully, but why the hell did they stop trying? I mean, jeez, if we can nail 682 and 076 down, why are we letting a random extra-strong humanoid walk free?

I've figured out what bothers me about this, actually: this object is not so much contained as appeased. The Foundation is letting it live in a cushy house and giving it D-class to eat, instead of locking it in a reinforced-concrete bunker and bolting it to the floor so that it'll quit murdering people. Its brethren are out there, and the Foundation hasn't so much as interrogated it to find out what they look like or what they're doing. Sure, it'll lie, but lies are frequently telling in themselves… and if the Foundation doesn't have some kind of xenopsychiatrists for analyzing exactly this kind of situation, then I'll eat my hat.

Letting a dangerous SCP object just do whatever it wants is deeply, jarringly out-of-character for the Foundation as I know them. :/

As for the awkward tone, I have to run right now, but I'll get you a critique in a little while.
